src: Street names + lines: Nebraska GIS Street_Centerlines (gis.ne.gov). Homes per street: 2020 Census blocks (Total_Housing, blocks under 40 units) shared to the nearest streets. Hail band per street: the real 2026 zone it sits in (data/storms-2026.json). Walk: shortest paths on the real street network. Built by data/build/areas.py.
